parent_objective: design a source-diverse old-key gap distribution refresh to replace singleton 9944 gap-floor bottleneck before more PPO

public_gates: do not run PPO in M338
design a source-diverse old-key/gap distribution refresh
preserve fixed 9944 as diagnostic but avoid singleton veto dominance
pre-register candidate acceptance metrics before any new PPO
admit a separate corpus-refresh or implementation milestone only
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower the old-key floor ad hoc
do not run PPO before the new gate is designed
hypothesis: Replacing the singleton old-key gap floor with a source-diverse old-key/gap distribution gate can retain old wrong-history evidence without forcing every PPO continuation through a single saturated scalar row.
success_criteria: design specifies how to mine or refresh old-key/gap rows
design specifies source diversity and dominance limits
design keeps 9944 as diagnostic while preventing singleton veto dominance
design admits a separate implementation or corpus-refresh milestone
failure_criteria: design does not define source diversity
design allows PPO before the gate exists

commands.name: m338_design
commands.command: Design the source-diverse old-key gap distribution gate and register the next implementation/corpus milestone without PPO.

decision_rule: M338 designs a source-diverse old-key/gap distribution gate and admits a no-PPO corpus refresh milestone. The design keeps 9944 as diagnostic and forbids ad hoc floor lowering or further PPO before the new gate exists.
